A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Uni-Renderer study with complete, readable main text and appendices. All 13 pages were compared; pages 2–13 render identically, and page 1 differs only in author information and the version stamp.

before.justification: v3 reports original rendering, inverse-rendering and relighting experiments in Tables 1–3, ablations in Section 4.3, and qualitative results throughout the main text and appendix.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Tables 1–3, Section 4.3 and the qualitative figures, including appendix Figures 9–11.

M1.justification: The dual-stream architecture, conditional timestep selection, latent preparation, training objectives and cycle-consistent constraint are unchanged, including the implementation description and Algorithm 1 in the appendix.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Objaverse assets, LHQ-1024 lighting environments, held-out synthetic objects and real-world examples for rendering, inverse rendering and relighting.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1–3 and the qualitative comparisons, including the InstructPix2Pix variants, Subias et al., Null-text inversion, RGB2X, NVdiffRec, GaussianShader and other inverse-rendering baselines.

E3.justification: The 100-object held-out evaluation, image resolution, metrics, training settings and baseline testing procedures are unchanged in Sections 3.3–4.2 and appendix Sections 6.2–6.4.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same unified-model and cycle-consistency ablations. Real-world cases and supplementary qualitative analyses also remain identical.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–3 and qualitative outputs in Figures 1–11 are unchanged. For example, the proposed method retains metallic-rendering PSNR 30.72 and albedo PSNR 23.20.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, rendering equation, diffusion formulation and losses in Equations 1–5 are identical. Neither version adds or revises formal assumptions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about unified rendering and inverse rendering, reduced ambiguity through cycle consistency, the synthetic dataset and demonstrated capabilities.

C2.justification: Interpretations of material edits, relighting and ablations are unchanged. The conclusion retains the same synthetic-to-real domain-gap limitation and proposed use of additional real-world training data.

D1.justification: Architecture details, data preparation, hardware, hyperparameters and baseline configurations are identical. Both versions retain the same promise to release training and inference code.

R1.justification: All 48 references and the related-work discussion are unchanged, including positioning relative to UniDiffuser and RGB2X.

P1.justification: v4 removes Hui Xiong from the author list and swaps the asterisk/dagger author markers while retaining the footnote legend. The version stamp changes; scientific prose and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: The shortened author line is recentered and the marginal version stamp changes on page 1. Figures, tables, captions and the remaining page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, results, figures, reproducibility details and appendices are unchanged. The limited title-page authorship, marker and version-stamp edits provide no evidence of a meaningful net improvement or deterioration in the paper's overall quality.
